name: Not Now
source:
We all know
We all know eventually, let's talk about it.

I know you don't want to go in to detail.

But we should talk about it.

Not now. It won't happen now. 

Don't worry.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230201194646/https://scratchikata.itch.io/not-now]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我们都知道。
我们都知道终有那么一天，谈谈吧。

我知道你不想细说。

可我们应该谈一谈。

现在不谈。现在还不会发生。

别担心。

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230201194646/https://scratchikata.itch.io/not-now]Itch.io[/url]]
